dimensions.evidence: Expression n / N divides count by count, yielding dimensionless frequency f. Variables declared count/count/dimensionless with units count/count/1. Consistent; no unit-scale error.

guards-inverses.evidence: Guards n >= 0, N > 0, n <= N fully bound the accounting proportion. Rejection cases cover class count exceeding census total (600 > 500, domain) and missing N. Inverse n = f*N verified by substitution 0.49*500 = 245, matching the YY reference; N = 0 correctly excluded (proportion over empty census undefined); n = 0 boundary (f = 0) admissible. No hidden branches or singularities; algebraic inversion is valid accounting, with no causal-invertibility overclaim.

reference-independence.evidence: Both references independently recomputed from published figure counts, not copied proportions: 245/500 = 0.49 (dominant-homozygote-frequency) and 210/500 = 0.42 (heterozygote-frequency), each matching the printed value; third class cross-check 45/500 = 0.09 consistent. Provenance honestly states values derived from counts. r2 ID rename verified correct: data are YY (245) and Yy (210) classes, so the old 'yy-*' IDs were misleading and the new IDs are accurate.

scope.evidence: Bounded accounting scope: observed within-sample proportion at one survey time; assumptions require complete census (counts sum to N) and attach no equilibrium or dynamics meaning; limitations explicitly distinguish this observed frequency from the Hardy-Weinberg predicted frequency against which it is compared, and exclude unsampled individuals. No empirical overclaim.

source-fidelity.evidence: Accessed OpenStax Biology 2e Section 19.1 (2018-03-28 web edition) 2026-11-01. Verified Figure 19.2 description: 500 individuals, 245 YY, 210 Yy, 45 yy with frequencies 0.49/0.42/0.09; allele-frequency definition as copies divided by total copies (part/total framing); Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium context matching the record's contrast. Accessed mirror page same date: extended Figure 19.2 description confirms YY .49 (245 of 500), Yy .42 (210), yy .09 (45). Introduced symbols n, N, f accurately disclosed as introduced; count-to-frequency pairing faithfully formalized.

models.permitted_use: Bounded permitted use: computing an observed genotype-class frequency as class count over census total within one complete, non-overlapping census for teaching, model composition, and comparison against Hardy-Weinberg predictions; not an estimator of equilibrium frequencies and not applicable with incomplete or overlapping classification.
